goal: FG-419: FlowGuard's own models: layered where a function is big, staged or dispatching; independent where they are different aspects or shared parts

components.summary: Dispatch supported read, change, target and release commands with fixed defaults; map aliases retain the same owners.
responsibilities: parse command lines and dispatch them to their owners Confirmation writes format 2 pointers and upgrades the map after all confirmed pointers are current. Models and release accept jobs 1-32 with sequential default; the hidden verify alias keeps its existing surface.
show owners, closest owners, target changes, Mermaid and reviews in read
annotate planned target breakage and ARCH lines in check, change and release
run release with the system root counted and optional whole-suite shards
run bound tests and, on request, the checks an edit needs
write templates and their aliases into the active target when one exists
hint splits for large scan drafts and say when discovery finds nothing
side_effects: writes .flowguard/map.json on scan, deps --write and confirm

components.summary: Check structural bindings, fixed model/test sizes and model-edit guards; only reasoned soft findings can be waived.
responsibilities: check anchors, files, imports, flow steps and models against the code Distinguish legacy fingerprint migration from real source staleness, using the same strict severity.
report one owner per entrypoint, responsibility, state and side effect
lint cycles, layers, sizes and private names, then apply accepted debts
explain entrypoints and state writers by model, test or reason

components.summary: Manage one target, classify current findings and native gaps, and promote only fresh complete code/model/test checks.
responsibilities: start, extend and drop one target; move tracked in-place edits safely and retain current files otherwise
classify merged-tree design errors, semantic rule changes, moved rules and genuine native code gaps
mark only the breakage of a changed subject as moving to target
refuse a target that changes nothing, drops a promise or leaves it untied
promote checked bytes atomically with transient recovery copies and name draft or stale components to confirm
warn about earlier findings, stale debts and untested rules without blocking
list what to re-read after promotion and which files to delete
include function-selected models and tests in the single promotion check
side_effects: writes current .flowguard/map.json and .flowguard/models/ only after a clean target check

components.summary: Explore every bounded input sequence and check loops without storing reusable verdicts.
responsibilities: explore every bounded input sequence

components.summary: Build feature-table proofs, replay native observations and declare every written feature State field.
responsibilities: replay model traces on the code
build one model per allowed feature set, honouring requires and conflicts
collect projected child start states from parent traces
name feature-kit rules and known-bad from the feature list alone

components.summary: Show field lifecycles, exact code ownership, distinct model relations and bounded test positions without importing models.
responsibilities: show the tree, Mermaid and digests with static facets and coverage
find owners by word form and rank architecture defects and strengths
compare current and target facets and list the rules a target changes
show the model rules and flows each component relies on

components.summary: Detect changed paths through a read-only Git index that preserves timestamp checks; select affected functions, ports, literals and tests.
responsibilities: select the checks a change needs and list its unexplained functions
select owned or closest reachable changed functions and matching flows; print relied models without selecting them
select bound and directly calling test functions, with conservative whole-file fallback
side_effects: reads git history; refreshes disposable analysis cache

flows.summary: an AI session reads the map
check the map and list what to run after editing code
run models with known-bad and conformance checks
release: the strict check, every model with its bound tests and, with --shards, the whole suite in subtrees
